verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe an internal 'Adaptive' model router and a /model command to switch between models Devin supports, but there is no evidence of a bring-your-own-API-key or custom LLM integration feature that lets engineering leads run agents on their own external model of choice. Missing for 10: any documentation of custom/BYO model or API key configuration, pricing implications of using your own LLM, or independent confirmation of this capability.
